answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 13826 Country: Pakistan Title: Assalam-o-Alikum, Mufti sahib I want to know that is it compulsory to take permission of the parents to go for umrah and haj? And also explain that I am doing job in Dubai and I want to go for umrah from here so parent's permission is must or not? jazakALLAH Question: Assalam-o-Alikum, Mufti sahib I want to know that is it compulsory to take permission of the parents to go for umrah and haj? And also explain that I am doing job in Dubai and I want to go for umrah from here so parent's permission is must or not? jazakALLAH Answer ID: 13826 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 997/940=B/1430) For hajj and umrah, it is not necessary to seek permission of parents, but seeking their advice and going on the pilgrimage with their consent and well wishes is appreciable and better, whether you go from Dubai or from your own country. The status of parents is very much higher. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
